subject: Mobile Development
title: The Super App Phenomenon
description: A fast breakdown of The Super App Phenomenon for builders.

hook.text: In China, WeChat is a messaging app, a bank, a store, a taxi service, and a government ID.

buildup.text: Super apps bundle dozens of services into one platform. Users never need to leave.

discovery.text: Grab in Southeast Asia and Gojek in Indonesia followed the super app model successfully.

twist.text: Western companies like Facebook and Uber tried the super app model but failed due to competition.

climax.text: Super apps thrive where one platform can dominate. Fragmented markets resist them.

punchline.text: One app to rule them all — but only in some markets.

quiz.question: Why haven't super apps succeeded in Western markets?
options: Too much competition from specialized apps
